justification: LOINC code 4548-4 represents hemoglobin A1c, which should range from approximately 4.0-14.0% in clinical practice; a value of 5.85% is physiologically plausible, but the unit code '%' is incorrect for this measurement—hemoglobin A1c should use the unit code '%{HbA1c}' or '%{of total Hgb}', not the generic '%' code.
